name: netcaster_spider_blocks_flyer_pumps
notes: P52a9efa29e G4. Printed: 'Reach' and 'Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.' On the opponent's turn a 2/3 flying Drake attacks; Netcaster Spider (2/3) is offered the block (reach) and blocks it. The trigger makes it 4/3, so it deals 4 and the Drake (toughness 3) dies; the Spider takes 2 and survives. Seat 0 takes no damage.
